journey.name: Enable developer mode
journey.description: Open the app, navigate to settings and enable developer mode then verify that the additional settings for developer mode are displayed.

actions.action: Tap "More" in the bottom navigation bar.
Tap "Settings" in the menu that opens.
Scroll down to the "General Settings" section.
Verify that a "Count screen redraws" switch is now displayed below the "Advanced/developer mode" switch.
Scroll down to the "Blockchain Settings" section.
Verify that blockchain source rows for the test networks are displayed in addition to NEXA.
Verify that the developer buttons "Log Info", "Reload Assets" and "Close P2P" are displayed.
